scenarios.name: 베어 풋 스프레드
scenarios.legs: 풋 매수 + 더 낮은 행사가 풋 매도
scenarios.risk: 만기 최대 손실 = 순지급 프리미엄. 최대 이익 = 행사가 차이 − 프리미엄.
scenarios.example: 기초자산 100 가정: 100 풋 매수 / 95 풋 매도, 비용 2 → 손익분기 98 · 최대 손실 2 · 최대 이익 3.

scenarios.name: 불 콜 스프레드
scenarios.legs: 콜 매수 + 더 높은 행사가 콜 매도
scenarios.risk: 만기 최대 손실 = 순지급 프리미엄. 최대 이익 = 행사가 차이 − 프리미엄.
scenarios.example: 기초자산 100 가정: 100 콜 매수 / 105 콜 매도, 비용 2 → 손익분기 102 · 최대 손실 2 · 최대 이익 3.

scenarios.name: 아이언 콘도르
scenarios.legs: 풋·콜 매도 + 양쪽 바깥 보호 옵션 매수
scenarios.risk: 만기 최대 이익 = 순수취 프리미엄. 최대 손실 = 더 넓은 날개 폭 − 프리미엄.
scenarios.example: 90 풋 매수 / 95 풋 매도 / 105 콜 매도 / 110 콜 매수, 수취 1 → 손익분기 94·106 · 최대 손실 4 · 최대 이익 1.

scenarios.name: 롱 스트래들
scenarios.risk: 만기 최대 손실 = 두 옵션의 총 프리미엄. 시간가치 감소·IV 하락에 유의.
scenarios.example: 행사가 100 가정: 콜 3 + 풋 3 지급 → 손익분기 94·106 · 최대 손실 6.

original_scenarios.then: Bear put spread · trade a confirmed breakdown
original_scenarios.how: A hawkish surprise is a trigger to reassess, not an automatic sell signal.
original_scenarios.entry: After the release, wait for price to break support and fail to reclaim it. Skip if price holds support or put premiums have already jumped beyond your budget.
original_scenarios.legs: Buy a put near spot; sell a lower-strike put near your downside target. Use equal size, the same underlying and expiry, typically 7–21 days out.
original_scenarios.exit: Close both legs near the lower strike, on a reclaim of broken support, or before expiry. A price stop is an exit plan, not a guaranteed fill.
original_scenarios.risk: Maximum expiry loss: net premium paid. Maximum expiry gain: strike gap minus premium.
original_scenarios.example: Illustration only: spot 100; buy 100 put / sell 95 put for a net 2. Expiry break-even 98; max loss 2; max gain 3.
original_scenarios.if: Hot CPI or a hawkish Fed

original_scenarios.then: Bull call spread · trade a confirmed breakout
original_scenarios.how: A rate cut can also signal weaker growth. Use the price reaction to confirm the bullish thesis.
original_scenarios.entry: Wait for price to break resistance and hold a retest. Skip a rejected breakout or a spread whose cost leaves too little upside to your target.
original_scenarios.legs: Buy a call near spot; sell a higher-strike call near your upside target. Use equal size, the same underlying and expiry, typically 7–21 days out.
original_scenarios.exit: Close both legs near the upper strike, if price loses the breakout level, or before expiry.
original_scenarios.risk: Maximum expiry loss: net premium paid. Maximum expiry gain: strike gap minus premium.
original_scenarios.example: Illustration only: spot 100; buy 100 call / sell 105 call for a net 2. Expiry break-even 102; max loss 2; max gain 3.
original_scenarios.if: Soft data or a dovish Fed — and price confirms

original_scenarios.then: Iron condor · sell a range with capped risk
original_scenarios.how: Consider only while option premiums remain rich versus your expected movement. Selling after volatility has already collapsed misses that repricing.
original_scenarios.entry: After the release, mark the range and confirm it is holding. Skip an active breakout, thin quotes, or a credit too small for the risk.
original_scenarios.legs: Sell a put below the range and a call above it; buy a lower put and a higher call as protection. Use equal size, one underlying and one expiry, typically 7–14 days out.
original_scenarios.exit: Example rule: close all four legs when half the opening credit is captured, when the range breaks, or before expiry. This rule is illustrative, not backtested.
original_scenarios.risk: Maximum expiry gain: credit received. Maximum expiry loss: wider wing gap minus credit.
original_scenarios.example: Illustration only: buy 90 put / sell 95 put / sell 105 call / buy 110 call for a net 1 credit. Expiry break-evens 94 and 106; max loss 4; max gain 1.
original_scenarios.if: Event passes; price stays inside its range

original_scenarios.then: Long straddle · buy movement only if fairly priced
original_scenarios.how: A shock alone is not a reason to buy volatility. The remaining move must justify the price of both options.
original_scenarios.entry: Compare the combined premium with your expected remaining move. Skip if panic premiums already price in that move; staying flat is a valid decision.
original_scenarios.legs: Buy a call and a put at the same strike near spot, with equal size, the same underlying and expiry, typically 7–14 days out.
original_scenarios.exit: Close both legs when the expected move arrives, if the catalyst fades, or before expiry. Time decay and falling implied volatility can hurt even after a price move.
original_scenarios.risk: Maximum expiry loss: total premium paid. Upside gain is uncapped; downside gain is capped by the underlying reaching zero.
original_scenarios.example: Illustration only: strike 100; pay 3 for the call + 3 for the put. Expiry break-evens 94 and 106; max loss 6. Earlier profit depends on volatility and time remaining.
original_scenarios.if: More large moves expected; direction unclear
